description: This file defines a ConfigStore responsible for managing application configuration data, including loading and saving configurations to local storage or remote servers, with support for overrides and testing.

classes.name: OverrideStore
classes.description: An actor class managing the override settings for the configuration, allowing setting and resetting override configurations.

methods.name: isRemoteMode
methods.description: Determines asynchronously whether the app is in remote mode, considering overrides and current app state.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads configuration data, choosing between remote and local sources based on the current mode and overrides.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the provided configuration data either remotely or locally, depending on the mode and overrides.

methods.name: loadFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches configuration data from a remote gateway.

methods.name: saveToGateway
methods.description: Saves configuration data to a remote gateway, handling encoding and hash management.

methods.name: _testSetOverrides
methods.description: Test helper method to set override configurations in debugging mode.

methods.name: _testClearOverrides
methods.description: Test helper method to clear override configurations in debugging mode.
